title: Scenario 4: tunnel users and a port to the gateway
task: The gateway cluster at 192.0.2.50 (on 1/1/13) should get employee traffic and the camera on 1/1/4 through tunnels. ClearPass already answers the laptop with role TUNNEL-EMPLOYEE. Build the UBT zone CAMPUS (primary controller 192.0.2.50, client VLAN 666), make TUNNEL-EMPLOYEE tunnel with gateway role authenticated (user-based), and tunnel everything on 1/1/4 with a fallback role PBT-IOT, gateway role iot (port-based).
hints: `ubt-client-vlan 666`, then `ubt zone CAMPUS vrf default` with `primary-controller ip 192.0.2.50` and `enable`. `show ubt` says whether the zone is up.
`port-access role TUNNEL-EMPLOYEE`, `gateway-zone zone CAMPUS gateway-role authenticated`. The switch has to know the role ClearPass sends, or the laptop fails authorization.
Port-based: `port-access role PBT-IOT` with `gateway-zone zone CAMPUS gateway-role iot`, then `port-access fallback-role PBT-IOT` on 1/1/4.
`show ubt users all` lists who is tunneled. The zone needs the gateway reachable: the switch already has 192.0.2.2 on VLAN 10.
